Method of Attack: Compromising air-gapped devices via USB removable media
Leeching documents and replicating onto removable media
Scanning victim system for documents with particular extensions
Intercepting connection of new removable media and copying data
Lateral movement by copying malware binary to removable drives
Initial infection via RTF documents or unknown means
Use of Remote-Access Trojans (RATs) deployed via political content RTF documents
Exploitation of CVE-2012-0158 via malicious Microsoft Word documents
Impacted Systems: Large organizations and government institutions in Vietnam
Defense, energy, and government sectors in Southeast Asian territories
Attack Vector: Malicious Microsoft Word documents exploiting CVE-2012-0158
Indicators of Compromise: File markers on drives such as '1.txt', '2.txt'
Presence of malware binary in '$Recyc1e.Bin' directory on removable drives
Domains and hashes published by Kaspersky
